questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.
The couple / preferred to walk / until the last house / of the town
questions.solution:
D) 'until'के बदले 'up to' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'up to' किसी सीमा तक का बोध कराता है जबकि 'until' समय की सीमा का बोध कराता है; जैसे— The couple preferred to walk up to the last house of the town.
'up to' will be used instead of 'until' because 'up to' indicates a limit or extent, whereas 'until' refers to a time limit; Like— The couple preferred to walk up to the last house of the town.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been divided into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.
Passengers started behaving / violent when / they were asked / to leave the bus station.
questions.solution:
C) 'Violent'के बदले 'violently' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'violent' Adjective है और 'behaving' को modify करने के लिए Adverb 'violently' का प्रयोग होगा; जैसे— Passengers started behaving violently when they were asked to leave the bus station.
'violently' will be used instead of 'violent' because 'violent' is an adjective, and to modify 'behaving,' an adverb 'violently' is required; Like— Passengers started behaving violently when they were asked to leave the bus station.

questions.question:

questions.solution: C) The correct spelling of ‘reconcider’ is ‘reconsider’which means “to think about (something) again, especially to consider changing a decision” फिर से विचार करना, पुनर्विचार करना

questions.question:
The given sentence is divided into four segments. Select the option that has the segment with a grammatical error.
She always / likes to / show on / her wealth.
questions.solution:
B) 'show on'केबदले 'show off' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'show off' एक phrasal verb है जिसका अर्थ है अपनी संपत्ति या विशेषता का दिखावा करना; जैसे— She always likes to show off her wealth.
'show off' will be used instead of 'show on' because 'show off' is a phrasal verb that means to display one's wealth or features; Like— She always likes to show off her wealth.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.
Hard had she / thrown the basketball / when it fell / on the ground.
questions.solution:
C) 'Hard had she'के बदले 'Hardly had she' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'hardly' का अर्थ है 'मुश्किल से', और यह वाक्य नकारात्मक अर्थ में है; जैसे— Hardly had she thrown the basketball when it fell on the ground.
'Hardly had she' will be used instead of 'Hard had she' because 'hardly' means 'barely' or 'with difficulty,' and the sentence implies a negative context; Like— Hardly had she thrown the basketball when it fell on the ground.

questions.question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.
Ramayana is an ancient Sanskrit epic; it is believed to be written around 500 BC to 100 BC
questions.solution:
D) 'The Ramayana'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'The' का उपयोग unique or specific items के लिए किया जाता है, और 'Ramayana' एक specific प्राचीन संस्कृत महाकाव्य है; जैसे— The Ramayana is an ancient Sanskrit epic; it is believed to have been written around 500 BC to 100 BC.
'The Ramayana' will be used because 'The' is used for unique or specific items, and 'Ramayana' is a specific ancient Sanskrit epic; Like— The Ramayana is an ancient Sanskrit epic; it is believed to have been written around 500 BC to 100 BC.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been divided into four segments. Identify the segment that contains an error.
Throw of / the old shoes; / nobody will wear / them now
questions.solution:
C) Throw of'के बदले'Throw away'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि english में सही phrasal verb 'Throw away' होता है, जो 'discard' या 'dispose of' के लिए प्रयुक्त होता है; जैसे— Throw away the old shoes.
'Throw away'will be used instead of 'Throw of' because in English, the correct phrase is 'Throw away', which is used for 'discard' or 'dispose of'; Like— Throw away the old shoes.

questions.question:
The given sentence is divided into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.
When it / come to football, / my brother is / an addict.
questions.solution:
D) ‘come' के बदले'comes'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'it' के लिए Third Person Singular Verb का प्रयोग किया जाता है; जैसे— When it comes to sports, she is very competitive.
'comes'will be used instead of 'come' because for 'it' the Third Person Singular Verb is used; Like— When it comes to sports, she is very competitive.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don't find any error, mark 'No error' as your answer.
The project was completed / more quicker / than expected
questions.solution:
B) 'more quicker' के बदले'quicker'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'more' और 'quicker' दोनों Comparative Degree हैं। अत: 'more' को हटाया जाएगा; जैसे— He runs quicker than his brother.
'quicker'will be used instead of 'more quicker' because 'more' and 'quicker' are both Comparative Degree. Therefore, 'more' will be removed; Like— He runs quicker than his brother.

questions.question:
Select the option that corrects the following sentence.
All the workers have called of the strike.
options: 1) All the workers have called between the strike.
2) All the workers have called off the strike.
3) All the workers have called at the strike.
4) All the workers have called through the strike
questions.solution:
B) All the workers have called off the strike.
'called of' के बदले 'called off' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'call off' का अर्थ होता है 'to cancel' या 'to end' (समाप्त करना); जैसे— All the workers have called off the strike.
'called off' will be used instead of 'called of' because 'call off' means 'to cancel' or 'to end'; Like— All the workers have called off the strike

questions.question:
The following sentence has been divided into four segments. Identify the segment that contains an error.
They have decided / to wind out / their business / without delay
questions.solution:
A) to wind out' के बदले'to wind up'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि ‘wind up’ का मतलब होता है किसी काम को ख़त्म करना या समाप्त करना, जबकि ‘wind out’ का कोई सही अर्थ नहीं है; जैसे— They have decided to wind up their business without delay.
'to wind up' will be used instead of 'to wind out' because 'wind up' means to finish or conclude something, while 'wind out' does not have a correct meaning; Like— They have decided to wind up their business without delay.

questions.question:
The given sentence is divided into four segments. Select the option that has the segment with a grammatical error.
He organises / a children’s fair every year / and his friends comes / to attend it.
questions.solution:
C) ‘comes' के बदले'come'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि subject 'his friends' Plural है अत: Verb भी Plural होगा; जैसे— He organises a children's fair every year and his friends come to attend it.
'come'will be used instead of 'comes' because the subject 'his friends' is Plural, so the Verb will also be Plural; Like— He organises a children's fair every year and his friends come to attend it.

questions.question:
The underlined phrase in the given sentence has been used incorrectly. Select the option that can correctly replace the underlined segment.
Samita (asked out) a favour of going early today
questions.solution:
C) 'asked for' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि पूरे संदर्भ में, वाक्य एक निवेदन की चर्चा कर रहा है। यहाँ "Samita (asked out) a favour of going early today" के माध्यम से उस निवेदन को दर्शाया जा रहा है, जिसमें समिता आज जल्दी जाने की अनुमति मांग रही है। इसलिए, "asked for" सबसे उपयुक्त विकल्प होगा।
‘asked for' should be used because in the entire context, the sentence is discussing a request. Here, through "Samita (asked out) a favour of going early today," it portrays that request where Samita is asking for permission to leave early today. Thus, "asked for" would be the most appropriate choice.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.
I goes to / attend dance classes at / the National Dance Academy.
questions.solution:
A) 'I goes to' के बदले 'I go to' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि Singular Noun के Subject होने पर Singular Verb का प्रयोग होता है, लेकिन Pronouns 'I' और 'you' के साथ Singular होने पर भी Singular Verb नहीं आता; जैसे— I go to attend dance classes at the National Dance Academy.
'I go to' will be used instead of 'I goes to' because when you have a singular noun as a subject, a singular verb follows. However, the pronouns "I" and "you" are singular, but singular verbs do not follow after them; Like— I go to attend dance classes at the National Dance Academy.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.
I noticed that they / did not went to / the museum but entered / a shopping complex.
questions.solution:
D) ‘did not went to' के बदले'did not go to'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि did के बाद हमेशा Verb का base form (first form) का प्रयोग होता है; जैसे— She did not attend the meeting.
'did not go to' will be used instead of 'did not went to' because after 'did', the base form (first form) of the verb is always used; Like— She did not attend the meeting

questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.
Since the little girl answers / a few simple questions, / her parents say that / she is too Intelligent
questions.solution:
D) 'too intelligent' के बदले 'very intelligent' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'too' का प्रयोग नकारात्मक अर्थ में किया जाता है और यहाँ सकारात्मक अर्थ में 'very' का प्रयोग उचित है; जैसे— Since the little girl answers a few simple questions, her parents say that she is very intelligent.
'very intelligent' will be used instead of 'too intelligent' because 'too' is used in a negative context, and here 'very' is more appropriate for a positive context; Like— Since the little girl answers a few simple questions, her parents say that she is very intelligent.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been divided into four segments. Identify the segment that contains an error in the usage of indefinite articles.
We took / an ice / and applied it on / the wound
questions.solution:
C) An ice' के बदले'some ice'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि ice uncountable noun है अत: उसके साथ indefinite article 'an' का प्रयोग नहीं होता; जैसे— We took some ice and applied it on the wound.
'some ice' will be used instead of 'an ice' because ice is an uncountable noun and hence, the indefinite article 'an' is not used with it; Like— We took some ice and applied it on the wound.

questions.question:
Select the option that corrects the following sentence.
What are you looking around?
questions.solution:
D) 'looking for' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'look for' का अर्थ है 'to search for' (खोजना); जैसे— What are you looking for?
'looking for' will be used instead of 'looking around' because 'look for' means 'to search for'; Like— What are you looking for?

questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.
It is difficult to live in (A) / the societal expectations (B)/ when one has (C) / fewer resources.
questions.solution:
D) 'live in the societal expectations' के बदले 'live up to societal expectations' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'live up to someone's expectation' का अर्थ है 'किसी की उम्मीद पर खरा उतरना'; जैसे— It is difficult to live up to societal expectations when one has fewer resources.
'live up to societal expectations' will be used instead of 'live in the societal expectations' because 'live up to someone's expectation' means 'to do as well as someone expects one to do'; Like— It is difficult to live up to societal expectations when one has fewer resources.
